keyPoints.en: Pure metals are soft and ductile because identical atoms form orderly layers that slide easily.
keyPoints.bm: Logam tulen lembut dan mulur kerana atom yang serupa membentuk lapisan teratur yang mudah menggelongsor.

keyPoints.en: An alloy contains foreign atoms of different sizes that disrupt the layers — harder and stronger.
keyPoints.bm: Aloi mengandungi atom asing bersaiz berbeza yang mengganggu lapisan — lebih keras dan kuat.

keyPoints.en: Alloys also resist corrosion and can look better (shinier) than the pure metal.
keyPoints.bm: Aloi juga tahan kakisan dan boleh kelihatan lebih menarik (berkilat) daripada logam tulen.

keyPoints.en: Examples: bronze, brass, steel, stainless steel, duralumin, pewter.
keyPoints.bm: Contoh: gangsa, loyang, keluli, keluli nirkarat, duralumin, piuter.

question.en: Why are aircraft bodies made of duralumin, not pure aluminium?
question.bm: Mengapa badan kapal terbang dibuat daripada duralumin, bukan aluminium tulen?

answer.en: Duralumin is still light but much stronger and harder than pure aluminium.
answer.bm: Duralumin tetap ringan tetapi jauh lebih kuat dan keras daripada aluminium tulen.

tip.en: Compare hardness with an experiment: drop a ball bearing onto the metal and measure the dent diameter.
tip.bm: Bandingkan kekerasan dengan eksperimen: jatuhkan bebola keluli pada logam dan ukur diameter lekuk.

keyPoints.en: Glass is made mainly from silica (SiO₂, sand), heated until molten and then cooled.
keyPoints.bm: Kaca dibuat terutamanya daripada silika (SiO₂, pasir), dipanaskan hingga lebur kemudian disejukkan.

keyPoints.en: Properties: transparent, hard but brittle, inert, electrical and heat insulator.
keyPoints.bm: Sifat: lutsinar, keras tetapi rapuh, lengai, penebat elektrik dan haba.

keyPoints.en: Types: fused silica (heat-resistant lenses), soda-lime (windows, bottles), borosilicate (lab glass, Pyrex), lead crystal (decorations).
keyPoints.bm: Jenis: silika terlakur (kanta tahan haba), soda kapur (tingkap, botol), borosilikat (kaca makmal, Pyrex), plumbum kristal (hiasan).

keyPoints.en: Special glass: photochromic (darkens in sunlight), tempered/safety glass (car windows).
keyPoints.bm: Kaca istimewa: fotokromik (menjadi gelap dalam cahaya matahari), kaca terbaja/keselamatan (tingkap kereta).

question.en: Why is soda-lime glass not used for test tubes heated strongly?
question.bm: Mengapa kaca soda kapur tidak digunakan untuk tabung uji yang dipanaskan kuat?

answer.en: It cracks with sudden temperature changes; borosilicate glass resists thermal shock.
answer.bm: Ia retak akibat perubahan suhu mendadak; kaca borosilikat tahan kejutan haba.

tip.en: Match glass type to property: heat resistance → borosilicate/fused silica; cheap → soda-lime; sparkle → lead crystal.
tip.bm: Padankan jenis kaca dengan sifat: tahan haba → borosilikat/silika terlakur; murah → soda kapur; berkilau → plumbum kristal.

keyPoints.en: Ceramics are made by shaping clay (e.g. kaolin, Al₂O₃·2SiO₂·2H₂O) and heating it to a very high temperature.
keyPoints.bm: Seramik dibuat dengan membentuk tanah liat (cth. kaolin, Al₂O₃·2SiO₂·2H₂O) dan memanaskannya pada suhu sangat tinggi.

keyPoints.en: Properties: very hard, brittle, high melting point, heat and electrical insulator, chemically inert.
keyPoints.bm: Sifat: sangat keras, rapuh, takat lebur tinggi, penebat haba dan elektrik, lengai secara kimia.

keyPoints.en: Traditional ceramics: pottery, bricks, tiles, porcelain. Advanced ceramics: spark plugs, brake discs, superconductors, body implants.
keyPoints.bm: Seramik tradisional: tembikar, bata, jubin, porselin. Seramik termaju: palam pencucuh, cakera brek, superkonduktor, implan badan.

keyPoints.en: Malaysian example: labu sayong pottery from Perak.
keyPoints.bm: Contoh Malaysia: tembikar labu sayong dari Perak.

question.en: Why are car spark plugs made of ceramic?
question.bm: Mengapa palam pencucuh kereta dibuat daripada seramik?

answer.en: Ceramic insulates electricity and withstands very high temperatures in the engine.
answer.bm: Seramik menebat elektrik dan tahan suhu sangat tinggi dalam enjin.

tip.en: Ceramics and glass are both brittle — they shatter rather than bend.
tip.bm: Seramik dan kaca sama-sama rapuh — pecah dan bukan bengkok.

keyPoints.en: A composite combines a matrix with a reinforcement to get better properties than either material alone.
keyPoints.bm: Komposit menggabungkan matriks dengan bahan pengukuh untuk mendapat sifat lebih baik daripada setiap bahan.

keyPoints.en: Reinforced concrete: concrete + steel — strong in compression and tension (bridges, buildings).
keyPoints.bm: Konkrit diperkukuh: konkrit + keluli — kuat dalam mampatan dan regangan (jambatan, bangunan).

keyPoints.en: Fibreglass: glass fibres + plastic — light, strong, waterproof (boats, helmets, water tanks).
keyPoints.bm: Gentian kaca: gentian kaca + plastik — ringan, kuat, kalis air (bot, topi keledar, tangki air).

keyPoints.en: Optical fibre (internet, endoscopes), photochromic glass (sunglasses), superconductors (MRI, maglev trains).
keyPoints.bm: Gentian optik (internet, endoskop), kaca fotokromik (cermin mata hitam), superkonduktor (MRI, kereta api maglev).

question.en: Give one advantage of fibreglass helmets over metal helmets.
question.bm: Berikan satu kelebihan topi keledar gentian kaca berbanding logam.

answer.en: Fibreglass is lighter, strong and doesn't rust.
answer.bm: Gentian kaca lebih ringan, kuat dan tidak berkarat.

tip.en: In essays, state the component materials AND the property each one contributes.
tip.bm: Dalam esei, nyatakan bahan komponen DAN sifat yang disumbangkan setiap satu.
